newsitem.title: USA: Black Hills acquires Jomax Partners.
newsitem.headline: Black Hills acquires Jomax Partners.

text.p: Black Hills Corp said it has purchased the assets of Jomax Partners LP, successor to Wickford Energy Marketing LC and Wickford Energy Marketing Canada Co.
Wickford is a niche wholesale natural gas and crude oil marketing company located in Houston, with expertise in Gulf Coast and Canadian supply, targeting the Midwest and East Coast merkets.

"Energy marketing companies are high sales, low margin businesses," Black Hills chief executive officer Daniel Landguth said in a news release dated Friday. "This acquisition has the potential of doubling or even tripling the company's consolidated revenues. However, the impact to consolidated earnings is expected to be in the three to five percent range, depending on market conditions."
Black Hills shares were down 1/16 at 28-11/16 Monday.
